prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to coastal cities.
Rising sea levels make a serious threat to coastal cities.
Rising sea levels give a serious threat for coastal cities.
Rising sea levels take a serious threat on coastal cities.

explanation: pose a threat to X 是固定搭配，主詞通常是「情況、風險」這類非人事物。同樣可說 pose a risk / pose a challenge / pose a question。

distractorExplanations.b: make a threat 指「（人）出言威脅」，主詞必須是人，海平面不會出言威脅。
distractorExplanations.c: give a threat 不是英文搭配，介系詞也應該用 to。
distractorExplanations.d: take a threat 不是英文搭配。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: Publishing the data was a clear breach of contract.
Publishing the data was a clear breach on contract.
Publishing the data was a clear breach to the contract.
Publishing the data was a clear break of contract.

explanation: breach of X 是固定搭配：a breach of contract／of trust／of security。

distractorExplanations.b: breach 後面固定接 of，不接 on。
distractorExplanations.c: breach to 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: break of contract 不是法律英文的說法；「違約」固定用 breach。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The committee finally reached a consensus on the deadline.
The committee finally arrived a consensus on the deadline.
The committee finally made a consensus on the deadline.
The committee finally took a consensus on the deadline.

explanation: consensus 最常搭配的動詞是 reach（也可說 reach agreement），意見的主題用 on。

distractorExplanations.b: arrive 是不及物動詞，要說 arrive at a consensus 才成立。
distractorExplanations.c: make a consensus 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: take a consensus 不是英文搭配；take 只能搭配 a vote。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The mayor paid tribute to the volunteers who ran the shelter.
The mayor did tribute to the volunteers who ran the shelter.
The mayor gave a tribute for the volunteers who ran the shelter.
The mayor took tribute to the volunteers who ran the shelter.

explanation: 「公開表達敬意」固定說 pay tribute to somebody，動詞用 pay。

distractorExplanations.b: do tribute 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.c: give a tribute 偶爾聽得到，但 for 用錯了，致敬的對象要用 to。
distractorExplanations.d: take tribute 意思會變成「收取貢品」，語意完全不同。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The second study was designed to test the hypothesis directly.
The second study was designed to experiment the hypothesis directly.
The second study was designed to prove out the hypothesis directly.
The second study was designed to trial the hypothesis directly.

explanation: 學術英文中，假設要 test（檢驗）；也可以說 support／reject a hypothesis。

distractorExplanations.b: experiment 是不及物動詞，要說 experiment with something。
distractorExplanations.c: prove out 不與 hypothesis 搭配，而且科學寫作避免說「證明」假設。
distractorExplanations.d: trial 當動詞是「試用（藥物、產品）」，不能接假設。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The tax break provides an incentive for firms to invest locally.
The tax break provides an incentive of firms to invest locally.
The tax break makes an incentive to firms to invest locally.
The tax break does an incentive for firms to invest locally.

explanation: incentive 的固定句型是 an incentive for somebody to do something，動詞用 provide、create、offer 或 give。

distractorExplanations.b: incentive of somebody 不是英文；of 只用於 an incentive of ten percent 這種數量說法。
distractorExplanations.c: make an incentive 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: do an incentive 不是英文搭配。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The new index is an order of magnitude faster than the old one.
The new index is an order in magnitude faster than the old one.
The new index is a level of magnitude faster than the old one.
The new index is a degree of magnitude faster than the old one.

explanation: an order of magnitude 是固定說法，表示「一個數量級（約十倍）」。

distractorExplanations.b: 介系詞錯誤，固定用 of。
distractorExplanations.c: a level of magnitude 不是英文說法。
distractorExplanations.d: a degree of magnitude 不是英文說法。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The new government has a clear mandate to reform the system.
The new government has a clear mandate for reform the system.
The new government has a clear mandate of reform the system.
The new government has a clear mandate about reform the system.

explanation: mandate 接動作時用不定詞：a mandate to do something。若要接名詞，才會說 a mandate for change。

distractorExplanations.b: for 後面必須接名詞（a mandate for reform），不能接原形動詞片語。
distractorExplanations.c: of 同樣不能接原形動詞，而且 mandate of 用於 the mandate of the committee 這種所有格關係。
distractorExplanations.d: about 不與 mandate 搭配。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: Investors are nervous about the prospect of higher interest rates.
Investors are nervous about the prospect to higher interest rates.
Investors are nervous about the prospect on higher interest rates.
Investors are nervous about the prospect about higher interest rates.

explanation: 單數 the prospect of X 表示「X 可能發生的前景」，介系詞固定用 of。（複數 prospects 才會說 prospects for growth。）

distractorExplanations.b: prospect to 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.c: prospect on 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: prospect about 不是英文搭配，而且與前面的 about 重複。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: Members cast their ballots in favour of the strike.
Members threw their ballots in favour of the strike.
Members gave their ballots in favour of the strike.
Members made their ballots in favour of the strike.

explanation: 投票的固定動詞是 cast：cast a ballot／cast a vote。

distractorExplanations.b: throw a ballot 不是英文搭配，字面意思變成把選票丟掉。
distractorExplanations.c: give a ballot 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: make a ballot 不是英文搭配。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The council voted to impose sanctions on the regime.
The council voted to impose sanctions to the regime.
The council voted to put sanctions at the regime.
The council voted to make sanctions on the regime.

explanation: impose sanctions on somebody 是固定搭配；同樣的句型還有 impose a ban on、impose restrictions on。

distractorExplanations.b: impose 的對象一律用 on，不用 to。
distractorExplanations.c: put sanctions at 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: make sanctions 不是英文搭配，制裁要用 impose 或 lift。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The ceremony was shortened in deference to local custom.
The ceremony was shortened in deference of local custom.
The ceremony was shortened by deference to local custom.
The ceremony was shortened under deference to local custom.

explanation: in deference to X 是固定片語，意思是「出於對 X 的尊重（而配合調整）」。

distractorExplanations.b: deference 後面固定接 to，不接 of。
distractorExplanations.c: by deference 不是英文片語。
distractorExplanations.d: under deference 不是英文片語。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: She treated the suggestion with disdain.
She treated the suggestion in disdain.
She treated the suggestion by disdain.
She treated the suggestion at disdain.

explanation: 表達態度的固定句型是 treat something with + 抽象名詞：with disdain／with respect／with caution。

distractorExplanations.b: in disdain 不是標準搭配；in 只用於 in contempt of court 這類法律片語。
distractorExplanations.c: by disdain 不是英文搭配。
distractorExplanations.d: at disdain 不是英文搭配。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: Two former ministers publicly endorsed the candidate.
Two former ministers publicly endorsed to the candidate.
Two former ministers publicly gave endorsement on the candidate.
Two former ministers publicly made an endorse of the candidate.

explanation: endorse 是及物動詞，直接接被支持的人或事物，不需要介系詞。

distractorExplanations.c: 名詞形式應為 gave their endorsement to the candidate，介系詞用 to。
distractorExplanations.d: endorse 沒有名詞用法，名詞是 endorsement。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: The department curtailed non-essential spending.
The department curtailed down non-essential spending.
The department curtailed off non-essential spending.
The department curtailed away non-essential spending.

explanation: curtail 本身已含「縮減」之意，是及物動詞，後面不加介副詞。

distractorExplanations.b: curtail down 是多餘的重複，英文沒有這個片語動詞。
distractorExplanations.c: curtail off 不是英文片語動詞。
distractorExplanations.d: curtail away 不是英文片語動詞。

prompt: Which combination is the most natural?

options.text: She left the firm to pursue a career in research.
She left the firm to pursue for a career in research.
She left the firm to pursue after a career in research.
She left the firm to make a pursue of a career in research.

explanation: pursue 是及物動詞，直接接受詞：pursue a career／a degree／an interest。

distractorExplanations.c: pursue after 是多餘的重複，pursue 已含「追求」之意。
distractorExplanations.d: pursue 沒有名詞用法，名詞是 pursuit。
